summary: OpenAI describes case studies of news organizations using its models, agents and custom GPTs across newsroom, audience, and business workflows.

practices.reason: Various customer usage stories mention custom GPTs and agents but describe no reusable technique or stated gain a team could implement.
practices.quote: The Daily Beast data team has built Data Scouts, a suite of OpenAI-powered agents that helps newsroom and business teams move more quickly from information to action.
